patch:
diff --git a/django/urls/base.py b/django/urls/base.py
index 0e1c3d909c..e47d9c3df3 100644
--- a/django/urls/base.py
+++ b/django/urls/base.py
@@ -172,7 +172,11 @@ def translate_url(url, lang_code):
         to_be_reversed = "%s:%s" % (match.namespace, match.url_name) if match.namespace else match.url_name
         with override(lang_code):
             try:
-                url = reverse(to_be_reversed, args=match.args, kwargs=match.kwargs)
+                # Unmatched optional named groups have a value of None. They
+                # must be removed before reversing so that the translated URL
+                # doesn't include them or "None" in place of them.
+                kwargs = {k: v for k, v in match.kwargs.items() if v is not None}
+                url = reverse(to_be_reversed, args=match.args, kwargs=kwargs)
             except NoReverseMatch:
                 pass
             else:
diff --git a/docs/releases/2.2.3.txt b/docs/releases/2.2.3.txt
index a42e57c779..966df890cf 100644
--- a/docs/releases/2.2.3.txt
+++ b/docs/releases/2.2.3.txt
@@ -12,3 +12,6 @@ Bugfixes
 * Fixed a regression in Django 2.2 where :class:`~django.db.models.Avg`,
   :class:`~django.db.models.StdDev`, and :class:`~django.db.models.Variance`
   crash with ``filter`` argument (:ticket:`30542`).
+
+* Made ``django.urls.translate_url()`` ignore optional URL parameters that
+  weren't provided.
